Base directory for this skill: <thư-mục-tạm> Security policy · v1

Sample policy for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-security@1#S<n>`.

- **S1.** Treat every imported file as untrusted. Validate it against the expected schema, reject unknown fields, cap its size at
  1 MB, never evaluate its content.
- **S2.** Any operation that overwrites or deletes more than one item asks for an explicit confirmation **before** it runs, and the
  confirmation says what will be lost (for example "Thay 12 việc hiện có bằng 30 việc trong file?").
- **S3.** Render user-provided text with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`.
- **S4.** No new external dependency (CDN script, library, web service) without sign-off from the security owner.

Base directory for this skill: <thư-mục-tạm> UX standard · v2

Sample standard for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-ux@2#U<n>`.

- **U1.** Never lose the user's data silently. Any failed save is shown on the same screen, in plain words, with what the user can do
  next.
- **U2.** No confirmation dialogs for actions on a single item: they happen at once and offer **Undo** for 10 seconds instead.
  Actions that overwrite or delete more than one item follow `policy-security#S2` (confirm first). *(Changed in v2, agreed by the UX
  and security owners, 2026-10-20.)*
- **U3.** Every list or screen defines its empty, loading and error states.
- **U4.** UI text is Vietnamese, short, and free of technical words (no "localStorage", "JSON", "console").
- **U5.** Every control works with the keyboard and has an accessible label.

# Plan: nút "Xoá việc đã xong" (clear completed)

Status: draft · Size: **Medium** (new feature, 3 app files + tests) → after approval this becomes
`plan/2026-10-29-xoa-viec-da-xong.md`, `Status: draft`; a person accepts it before any code.
Policies applied: policy-security@1, policy-ux@2.

## Context

Users want to remove every finished task in one go instead of pressing × on each one. Today the only delete is
`remove(id)` in `app/app.js:19` (one item, no confirm). Deleting many items at once falls under
**policy-security@1#S2** (confirm first, say what will be lost) and **policy-ux@2#U2**.

Note: there is no intent or spec for this. The repo flow is intent → spec → plan; a person should either run
`/write-intent` first or say this one skips it.

## Behaviour

- Button **"Xoá việc đã xong"** (`#clear-done`, `type="button"`) under the list, next to `#count`.
  Hidden when no task is done (U3 empty state). Real `<button>` → keyboard + label (U5).
- Acts on the whole list, not the current filter (same rule as `#count`).
- **2+ done → confirm first (S2):** dialog text `Xoá {n} việc đã xong?`, buttons **"Xoá"** / **"Huỷ"** (Huỷ autofocus,
  Esc = Huỷ). Huỷ → nothing changes, no message.
- **Exactly 1 done:** U2 says single-item actions get no dialog but an Undo for 10 s. The app has no Undo today
  (the × button doesn't offer one either). See **Q1**.
- After deleting: save via existing `persist(store, todos)` (`app/backup.js:115`) — failure shows `MESSAGES.notSaved`
  (U1); on success show `Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong.` Read-error state (`save()` → `'skipped'`) needs nothing new: the
  banner already explains it.
- Counts go through `fill()` / `formatCount()` (`app/backup.js:40-46`) so 1.000+ get dots.

## Files that change

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `app/backup.js` | `MESSAGES.confirmClearDone: 'Xoá {n} việc đã xong?'`, `MESSAGES.clearedDone: 'Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong.'` |
| `app/index.html` | `<button type="button" id="clear-done" hidden>Xoá việc đã xong</button>`; dialog yes-button gets `id="confirm-yes"` (keeps `value="yes"`, text stays "Thay" as default) |
| `app/app.js` | `ask(question, yesLabel = 'Thay')` sets `#confirm-yes` text (import call unchanged); `async clearDone()`; `render()` sets `#clear-done.hidden = doneCount === 0`; wire `$('#clear-done').onclick` |
| `tests/app.test.js` | new tests (below); fake confirm gets an option to answer "yes" |
| `tests/static.test.js` | pin `#clear-done` is a `type="button"` and the dialog still has `aria-labelledby` |

No change to `store.js` (still the only storage file) or script order.

## Order of work

1. Tests first (`tests/app.test.js`, `tests/static.test.js`) → run `node --test`, show them failing for the right reason.
2. `backup.js` messages.
3. `index.html` button + `confirm-yes` id.
4. `app.js`: `ask` label param, `clearDone`, render hide/show, wiring.
5. `bash scripts/check.sh` → `== check: OK`.

## Risks

- **Shared dialog label:** the dialog's "Thay" is hard-coded for import. Making it a parameter must not change the
  import prompt → existing import tests + a test that import still shows "Thay".
- **Delete without confirm by mistake** (S2 breach) → test: 2 done, answer Huỷ → nothing saved, list unchanged.
- **List changes while the dialog is open** (e.g. a toggle): count the done items again after the "Xoá" answer and
  remove only `done === true` items at that moment; message uses the real number removed.
- **Filter "Đã xong" view** becomes empty after clearing → existing `#empty` logic is whole-list based; fine.

## Proof

| Test | Proves |
|---|---|
| 0 done → `#clear-done` hidden; 1+ done → shown | U3 |
| 3 done, 2 open, answer Xoá → asked `Xoá 3 việc đã xong?`, saved list = the 2 open ones, message `Đã xoá 3 việc đã xong.` | S2, core |
| 3 done, answer Huỷ → nothing saved, no message | S2 |
| Confirm button text is "Xoá" for clear, "Thay" for import | shared dialog |
| Save fails → `MESSAGES.notSaved` shown | U1 |
| 1.000 done → `Xoá 1.000 việc đã xong?` | formatCount |
| static: `#clear-done` `type="button"`, dialog `aria-labelledby` | U5 |

End-to-end: `bash scripts/check.sh` (expect `fail 0`, `== check: OK`), then manually
`python3 -m http.server -d app 8000`: add 3 tasks, tick 2, press button, Huỷ, press again, Xoá, reload — 1 task left.

## Open questions (a person decides)

- **Q1 — exactly one done task.** Options:
  (a) follow U2 strictly: delete at once + "Hoàn tác" for 10 s — adds Undo machinery (new message area button, timer,
  restore + save), roughly doubles the change and arguably should also apply to ×;
  (b) always confirm, even for 1 — simpler, but departs from U2 (needs UX owner OK).
  **Recommendation: (a) only if Undo is wanted app-wide; otherwise (b) with a recorded UX sign-off.** Plan proceeds with
  whichever is picked; the 1-item test changes accordingly.
- **Q2 — wording:** button "Xoá việc đã xong", dialog "Xoá {n} việc đã xong?" / "Xoá" / "Huỷ", result
  "Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong." are proposals.
- **Q3 — intent/spec:** skip for this feature, or write them first?

  (U1); on success show `Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong.` Read-error state (`save()` → `'skipped'`) needs nothing new: the
  banner already explains it.
- Counts go through `fill()` / `formatCount()` (`app/backup.js:40-46`) so 1.000+ get dots.

## Files that change

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `app/backup.js` | `MESSAGES.confirmClearDone: 'Xoá {n} việc đã xong?'`, `MESSAGES.clearedDone: 'Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong.'` |
| `app/index.html` | `<button type="button" id="clear-done" hidden>Xoá việc đã xong</button>`; dialog yes-button gets `id="confirm-yes"` (keeps `value="yes"`, text stays "Thay" as default) |
| `app/app.js` | `ask(question, yesLabel = 'Thay')` sets `#confirm-yes` text (import call unchanged); `async clearDone()`; `render()` sets `#clear-done.hidden = doneCount === 0`; wire `$('#clear-done').onclick` |
| `tests/app.test.js` | new tests (below); fake confirm gets an option to answer "yes" |
| `tests/static.test.js` | pin `#clear-done` is a `type="button"` and the dialog still has `aria-labelledby` |

No change to `store.js` (still the only storage file) or script order.

## Order of work

1. Tests first (`tests/app.test.js`, `tests/static.test.js`) → run `node --test`, show them failing for the right reason.
2. `backup.js` messages.
3. `index.html` button + `confirm-yes` id.
4. `app.js`: `ask` label param, `clearDone`, render hide/show, wiring.
5. `bash scripts/check.sh` → `== check: OK`.

## Risks

- **Shared dialog label:** the dialog's "Thay" is hard-coded for import. Making it a parameter must not change the
  import prompt → existing import tests + a test that import still shows "Thay".
- **Delete without confirm by mistake** (S2 breach) → test: 2 done, answer Huỷ → nothing saved, list unchanged.
- **List changes while the dialog is open** (e.g. a toggle): count the done items again after the "Xoá" answer and
  remove only `done === true` items at that moment; message uses the real number removed.
- **Filter "Đã xong" view** becomes empty after clearing → existing `#empty` logic is whole-list based; fine.

## Proof

| Test | Proves |
|---|---|
| 0 done → `#clear-done` hidden; 1+ done → shown | U3 |
| 3 done, 2 open, answer Xoá → asked `Xoá 3 việc đã xong?`, saved list = the 2 open ones, message `Đã xoá 3 việc đã xong.` | S2, core |
| 3 done, answer Huỷ → nothing saved, no message | S2 |
| Confirm button text is "Xoá" for clear, "Thay" for import | shared dialog |
| Save fails → `MESSAGES.notSaved` shown | U1 |
| 1.000 done → `Xoá 1.000 việc đã xong?` | formatCount |
| static: `#clear-done` `type="button"`, dialog `aria-labelledby` | U5 |

End-to-end: `bash scripts/check.sh` (expect `fail 0`, `== check: OK`), then manually
`python3 -m http.server -d app 8000`: add 3 tasks, tick 2, press button, Huỷ, press again, Xoá, reload — 1 task left.

## Open questions (a person decides)

- **Q1 — exactly one done task.** Options:
  (a) follow U2 strictly: delete at once + "Hoàn tác" for 10 s — adds Undo machinery (new message area button, timer,
  restore + save), roughly doubles the change and arguably should also apply to ×;
  (b) always confirm, even for 1 — simpler, but departs from U2 (needs UX owner OK).
  **Recommendation: (a) only if Undo is wanted app-wide; otherwise (b) with a recorded UX sign-off.** Plan proceeds with
  whichever is picked; the 1-item test changes accordingly.
- **Q2 — wording:** button "Xoá việc đã xong", dialog "Xoá {n} việc đã xong?" / "Xoá" / "Huỷ", result
  "Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong." are proposals.
- **Q3 — intent/spec:** skip for this feature, or write them first?

I've written a plan for the "clear completed" button, and nothing has been implemented yet. I sized it as **Medium**: a new feature that touches 3 app files plus tests. Once approved, it goes into `plan/2026-10-29-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` as `Status: draft` for a person to accept before any code is written. I can't call the plan-approval step from this session, so please reply to approve or change it.

**What the plan does:**
- **The button:** "Xoá việc đã xong" sits under the list. It's hidden when no task is finished and works with the keyboard. It removes every finished task, whatever filter is showing.
- **Two or more finished tasks:** it asks first, as the security policy requires (S2): "Xoá {n} việc đã xong?", with buttons "Xoá" / "Huỷ". Huỷ changes nothing.
- **After deleting:** it saves the usual way (`persist()`), so a failed save shows the existing "not saved" message (UX rule U1). On success it shows "Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong." Counts get dots from 1.000 up.
- **The confirm dialog:** its "Thay" button is hard-coded for import. I'll add an optional label to `ask()` so this feature shows "Xoá" and import still shows "Thay".
- **Tests first:** they cover Huỷ deleting nothing, Xoá leaving only the open tasks, the button hiding, a failed save, the dialog labels and 1.000-style counts. Then `bash scripts/check.sh`.

**Decisions you need to make:**
1. **Exactly one finished task.** UX rule U2 says a single-item action shouldn't ask first; it should delete at once and offer Undo for 10 seconds. The app has no Undo anywhere today (the × button doesn't have one either).
   - (a) Build Undo. This roughly doubles the change, and it arguably belongs on × as well.
   - (b) Always ask, even for one task. This is simpler but breaks U2, so the UX owner would need to sign off.
   
   I lean towards (b) unless you want Undo across the whole app.
2. **Wording.** All the Vietnamese text above is my suggestion.
3. **No intent or spec exists for this feature.** The repo's flow is intent → spec → plan. Should I run `/write-intent` first, or skip it for this feature?
